text: Found it: in middleware/proxy.go the balancers panic when they have no targets (randomBalancer indexes an empty slice, roundRobinBalancer does `i % 0`), and the middleware dereferences the target unconditionally. Fix: balancers return nil on empty target lists, and ProxyWithConfig returns echo.ErrServiceUnavailable (503) when Next yields no target. Implementing and running the middleware + repo test suites now.

Fixed and verified.

Bug: in middleware/proxy.go, a balancer with no targets crashed the request — randomBalancer.Next called rand.Intn(0) and roundRobinBalancer.Next computed `b.i % 0`, and ProxyWithConfig then dereferenced the (nil/absent) target.

Fix (only middleware/proxy.go touched):
- randomBalancer.Next and roundRobinBalancer.Next now return nil when the target list is empty.
- ProxyWithConfig returns echo.ErrServiceUnavailable (HTTP 503) when Next yields no target, before touching the target.

Verification: a test of the shape of TestProxyBalancerWithNoTargets (NewRandomBalancer(nil) + e.Use(Proxy(rb)) -> 503) passes, as does the round-robin equivalent; without the fix the same test panics with "invalid argument to Intn". `go build ./...`, `go vet ./middleware/` and `go test ./... -count=1` are all green, no pre-existing test changed or broken, and no test files were modified (temp test files removed; git status shows only middleware/proxy.go modified).
